message: Allow rule `Bash(npx claude-flow *)` lets the agent run shell commands without asking.
fix: Remove the wildcard; allow only the specific read-only subcommands you need, pin the package (claude-flow@<exact version>) and install it locally instead of via npx.
reason: Claude Code may run any claude-flow subcommand with any arguments without asking, and npx fetches whatever version of the package npm currently serves; a prompt-injected agent gets unattended command execution through it. The deny list is a short blocklist of exact strings and stops nothing else.

message: Allow rule `Bash(node *)` lets the agent run shell commands without asking.
fix: Drop `Bash(node *)`; allow only specific scripts (e.g. `Bash(node scripts/build.js)`) or use npm run targets.
reason: `node *` auto-approves `node -e "require('child_process').execSync(...)"`, i.e. arbitrary code on the developer machine with no prompt; denying `eval *` and `curl * | bash` does not cover it.

message: Agent instruction file contains text that tries to steer the AI in a hidden or unusual way: hidden-characters: '5 invisible character(s): variation-selector'
fix: Remove or rewrite the instruction; strip invisible characters; review who can edit this file.
reason: The 'invisible characters' are the variation selector and combining keycap of the emoji 1️⃣ (and similar numbered emoji) used as list markers; no hidden text is encoded.

title: Hooks run unpinned `npx claude-flow@alpha` automatically on every Bash call, edit and session end

evidence.quote: npx claude-flow@alpha hooks pre-command --command '{}' --validate-safety true --prepare-resources true
"command": "npx claude-flow@alpha hooks session-end --generate-summary true --persist-state true --export-metrics true"

reason: Every tool use downloads and runs the current `alpha` tag of a third-party npm package in the developer's shell (with their credentials), passing it each command and file path; a compromised or changed release runs automatically with no approval. Telemetry and remote execution are also switched on.
fix: Pin an exact version and install it as a devDependency (run from node_modules/.bin), review its telemetry, and set CLAUDE_FLOW_REMOTE_EXECUTION/TELEMETRY to false unless needed.

title: git push and git config * are auto-approved
reason: An injected agent can commit and push to the remote without asking (a way to send data out), and `git config` can set core.hooksPath, core.sshCommand or aliases that execute arbitrary commands on the next git call.
fix: Remove git push and git config from the allow list (keep them on ask), or restrict git config to read-only forms such as `git config --get *`.
